notes.title: Ver1.5Update
notes.content: [p]Half the year has already passed—but the second half is still ahead! There’s still time to turn things around!![/p][p]Now, here’s the update we previously announced, adding archive and conversation log features.[/p][p]We’ve also made changes to reduce randomness and adjust difficulty.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Feature Updates[/h2][h3]Archive Feature Added[/h3][p]An archive viewing feature has been added to the home screen.[/p][p]You can now revisit past story and upgrade-related conversation events.[/p][p]Reaching what's considered the "good ending" unlocks all conversation events for viewing.[/p][h3]Log Feature[/h3][p]Two types of logs have been implemented:[/p][p]One is accessible from the Esc menu. It saves texts from conversation scenes, unique in-game dialogue, and pre-game tips.[/p][p]The other is a log specific to conversation scenes, which you can access by pressing the L key. It records only the current scene’s dialogue.[/p][h3]Minimum Guarantee[/h3][p]Whenever possible, the first few customers are selected based on specific criteria.[/p][p]These criteria may continue to be reviewed and adjusted in the future.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Changes[/h2][h3]Relaxed Requirements for Obtaining the Alarm Clock[/h3][p]We’ve made adjustments to prevent certain upgrades from replacing development paths that lead to the alarm clock.[/p][p]Now, even if you develop the Super Accelerator or the Charity Campaign, it’s still possible to develop the Alarm Clock.[/p][h3]Adjusted Appearance Timing for Personalizers β and γ[/h3][p]Personalizer β now appears from Day 3 onward, and γ from Day 5 onward.[/p][h3]Slight Adjustment to How Personalizers Affect Customer Satisfaction[/h3][p]Each Personalizer now has a slight positive effect on satisfaction when linked to the corresponding dream.[/p][p]α and β have half the effect of the "Dedicated Pillow," while γ has double the effect of α and β.[/p][h3]Clarified Flavor Text[/h3][p]Descriptions of upgrades have been updated to clearly distinguish between in-game effects and unrelated flavor text.[/p][h3]Other Small Tweaks[/h3][list][*][p]Slight adjustment to the description of "Charm"[/p][/*][*][p]Reinserted some omitted tutorial text[/p][/*][*][p]Made the snarky tutorial a bit more tolerable[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted volume levels for some background music[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked conversation branching conditions for “Steady Promotion Activity”[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where various parameters weren’t changing as expected on specific dates.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version1.5, and......
notes.content: [p]It’s getting hot, and the sweltering, tropical nights have begun—making sleep a struggle. Please take good care of yourself during this season.[/p][p][/p][h2]🛠 Update Plans for Ver. 1.5[/h2][p]We had hoped to release this in June, but we've fallen behind schedule due to our own shortcomings in time management.[/p][h3]Archive Function[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312837/d7969d7ddfe9c2cfa1ae39fd2be554f70cde57b0.png"][/img][/p][p]You’ll be able to access a home-menu view of past story events and upgrade-related conversations.[/p][p]While it’s not our intent for players to have to unlock every single event, we still want to let you view any that you haven’t seen under certain conditions.[/p][h3]Log Function[/h3][p]We’re still working out the details, but we plan to let you review your most recent in-game text.[/p][h3]Minimum Guarantee[/h3][p]We’ve received feedback that in later stages, players sometimes face only nightmares repeatedly, forcing a frustrating restart.[/p][p]To address this, we’re considering tweaking the conditions for selecting the first one or two dreams. [/p][p]Since we can't provide what's not available, please just be mindful not to accumulate too many nightmares.[/p][p]Randomness can be both helpful and harmful at certain difficulty levels, so adjusting it is tricky—but we hope these changes will reduce that sense of emptiness.[/p][h3]Upgrade Adjustments[/h3][p]We’ll relax the requirements for the Alarm Clock upgrade and adjust the appearance conditions for the Personalizer line.[/p][p]At the moment, using the Alarm Clock practically forces players to rely on pausing, but we’d like to make it available even after obtaining the “Super Accelerator.” We think it’s fine to allow some challenges, but based on rewards and player needs, this would make more sense.[/p][p]We’ll also slightly tweak the Personalizer to have a noticeable effect on customer satisfaction.[/p][p]On top of feature changes, the upgrade descriptions also need work—we’ll try to better distinguish flavor text from functional info and add a bit more clarity where possible, without overloading the text.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re targeting a July release for this update.[/p][p][/p][h2]🚀 Major Update: Ver. 2.0[/h2][p]In line with showcasing at gaming events in the second half of the year, we’ve begun development on Ver. 2.0, which will include a major expansion of story content and stages.[/p][p]You may finally learn more about the mysterious figure who brokered the unknown protagonist, and perhaps the deeper goals of “Good Sleep Company”…[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312837/5d2cf97d461ca96523df58bd94c8164f65b38db0.png"][/img][/p][p]Look forward to new dreams, fresh upgrades, and tougher trials![/p][p][/p][p]We’re aiming to release Ver. 2.0 after September.[/p]

notes.title: We’re exhibiting at Tokyo Game Dungeon 8!
notes.content:
GoodSleepCompany will be exhibiting at the indie game showcase Tokyo Game Dungeon 8, held on Sunday, May 4 at the Tokyo Metropolitan Industrial Trade Center Hamamatsuchō Building, 2nd and 3rd Floor Exhibition Halls!
Tokyo Game Dungeon 8 Official Website
Event Overview

Date & Time: Sunday, May 4, 2025, from 12:00 PM to 5:00 PM
Venue: Tokyo Metropolitan Industrial Trade Center, Hamamatsuchō Building – 2nd & 3rd Floor Exhibition Halls
Access:

    5-minute walk from JR / Tokyo Monorail Hamamatsuchō Station

    7-minute walk from Toei Asakusa Line / Ōedo Line Daimon Station

    2-minute walk from Yurikamome Takeshiba Station

We’ll be waiting for you at booth 2H-7!
Whether you’ve played our games before or are trying them out for the first time, come by and have some fun!

We’re also hoping to have a playable demo of our upcoming title, which is currently in active development. Stay tuned!

notes.title: 1.04.00 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312837/22ef9c3df815d57ca7f06dbc014c30a3746e69ce.png[/img]

- Added in-game dialogues
    * About credit status
    * About progress status
- Added 3 new BGM tracks
    * Adjusted conditions for certain BGM to play

# Other Update
- Extended the time before automatic deletion of customer information
- Increased difficulty for triggering the charity campaign
- Automatic check for tutorial skip
- Replaced some character illustrations

# Tweaks
- Reduced load impact when starting the game
- Restricted pausing during the ending sequence
- Restricted pausing during loading screens
- Fixed an issue where some translations were missing when exiting the game
- Internal adjustments related to Steamworks
